from.method: Sentinel-2 satellite-derived bathymetry, Stumpf log-ratio, uncalibrated

fittedAgainst.chosenOn: the worst depth band, not the overall rms: the summary belongs to whichever band holds the most points, and over Al Fahal that was the one already fine
fittedAgainst.note: derived from Sentinel-2 and rescaled to measured depths. Not a survey: a derived seabed with a known error rather than an unknown one.

checkedAgainst.note: positive means this seabed says shallower than the laser measured. Depths along tracks, not a grid.

reef.sizesFrom: a draw against the prototype's own size, capped by the depth band; nobody measured any of these

cover.from: Allen Coral Atlas benthic map of this reef, 10 m, CC BY 4.0

habitatFrom.why: the place says what it is made of — a survey's habitat polygons, or a composed reef's own parts — rather than this working it out from the shape. 67% of the site is reef habitat and that is a fact about the place, not an inference that failed to discriminate.

coverPaidFor.why: the colony ceiling binds: this reef is built at the density the budget allows and not at the cover its map asks for

beginAt.within: the band a vehicle works a reef in, 8 to 18 m

coverMeasuredBy.over: the reef habitat this place was planted into, which is what a transect figure is cover of
coverMeasuredBy.statistic: all the colony area over all the reef habitat, saturated as 1 - exp(-A/G) because colonies are scattered rather than tiled

assemblage.name: red-sea
assemblage.from: The platform Red Sea mix, from Khalil, Bouwmeester and Berumen 2017 (PeerJ 5:e3410) line-intercept transects off Thuwal, nine reefs, Al Fahal one of the three midshelf ones and the richest at 23 hard-coral genera

ground.hardnessFrom: habitat polygons from a survey of this place, and the slope and relief of the seabed where the survey did not reach
ground.colourFrom: orthomosaic and habitat classes from a survey

waterBakedFrom.why: no per-pixel value reaches an expression in this renderer, so how much of each colour survives the swim to the camera is worked out here and written into a map. A texture lookup is the thing that does work. It is measured from where dives begin: a vehicle that swims far from this point carries water measured from this point, and a different water type needs this run again.

life.perSquareMetreFrom: visual census of reef fish over ~8 cm, order 0.05-0.2 per m2; not measured at this site

water.from: Kd(PAR) 0.049-0.119 per metre at the pelagic station offshore of KAUST: Overmans & Agusti 2020, Front. Mar. Sci. 7:111. Al Fahal is twenty minutes off the KAUST pier, so this is that station own water rather than a reading carried from elsewhere. IB is the nearest type the renderer has been held against and errs towards more attenuation than the measurement.
